inputs.contract: Project: FitTrack MVP, a fitness tracking app for iOS and Android (React Native). Fixed feature list: 1) email sign-up and login, 2) workout log (add, edit, delete workouts), 3) weekly progress chart, 4) user profile page. Fixed price: $6,000, delivery in 6 weeks. Anything not on the feature list is out of scope and quoted separately.
inputs.thread:
Kasper: hey Mina, tested the build on my phone, login works 👍
Mina: great to hear!
Kasper: can we get push notifications when someone misses a workout day? would be really nice for retention
Mina: Push notifications aren't on the feature list, so that would be extra. Want me to estimate?
Kasper: lol not now, lets focus on launch
Kasper: what about dark mode? my testers keep asking
Mina: Dark mode could be small, depends on how the screens are built. I'll look at it
Kasper: cool
Kasper: we'll also need a simple admin dashboard so my coach can see user stats
Mina: That's separate work. Roughly $900 for a basic read-only dashboard with a user list and weekly stats
Kasper: ok approved, $900 is fine. please go ahead and build it
Mina: Perfect, I'll add it to the plan
Kasper: quick question - could the app also let users share their weekly chart to instagram? shouldnt be hard right?
Mina: That needs a share-image feature, not on the list. Let me check the effort
Kasper: ok
Mina: Next build comes Monday
Kasper: 👍
